chart.description: Displays a chart (lines, bars or pie) in the AgentUI chat. Use it to illustrate numeric data; accompany it with a sentence of explanation. Returns a [[agentui:…]] token: write it as is in your reply, where the component should appear, and never write the JSON yourself.

kind.description: line = trend, bar = comparison, pie = breakdown (a single series).

y.description: As many numbers as labels in x.

map.description: Locates 1 to 10 places on an OpenStreetMap map in the AgentUI chat. Only give coordinates you are sure about. Returns a [[agentui:…]] token: write it as is in your reply, where the component should appear, and never write the JSON yourself.

maps.description: Adds a global "Open in Maps" button (place page, or route in point order).

text.description: Markdown displayed in the point's popup.

maps.description: "Open in Maps" button on this point.

code.description: Presents a code or configuration excerpt or a diff (line numbers, highlighting, Copy button) in the AgentUI chat. Reserve it for excerpts the user will want to copy or reread. Returns a [[agentui:…]] token: write it as is in your reply, where the component should appear, and never write the JSON yourself.

language.description: ts, js, python, bash, json, yaml, sql, html, css, or diff (+ / - lines).

highlight.description: Lines to highlight: numbers or ranges like "6-7".

start.description: Number of the first line (1 by default).

table.description: Displays a data table (column sorting, folding of long tables, CSV copy) in the AgentUI chat. Use it to compare several items on several criteria; accompany it with a sentence of explanation. Returns a [[agentui:…]] token: write it as is in your reply, where the component should appear, and never write the JSON yourself.

unit.description: Unit displayed after each number of the column.

items.description: One value per column, in order. null = empty cell.

progress.description: Displays a checklist of steps with a progress bar for a long task (several steps, chained tools), which you update as the work goes. The component appears automatically at the top of your reply from the first call: NEVER write the token in your text. For each update, call the tool again with `update` = the token returned by the first call and the COMPLETE state of all steps; the component changes in place. Set the current step to `running`, finish it with `done` (or `failed`) before moving to the next. Create only one per task; pointless for a short task.

detail.description: Short note displayed under the step (progress, error…).

update.description: [[agentui:…]] token returned by the first call, to update this component instead of creating another one.

image.description: Displays one or more images (gallery with full-screen viewer) in the AgentUI chat. `src`: an https://… URL OR an absolute path of a file on your machine (png, jpeg, gif or webp, 20 MB max) that the plugin copies and serves to the user; use neither data: nor file:. Caption per image is optional. Accompany the images with a sentence of explanation. Returns a [[agentui:…]] token: write it as is in your reply, where the component should appear, and never write the JSON yourself.

src.description: https://… URL or absolute path of an image file on your machine.

tokenInstruction: Place this token as is in your reply, where the component should appear.

ask.description: Asks the user a question in AgentUI (choice buttons or free answer) and waits for the answer. Use only if you really need information. The tool BLOCKS until the user answers and returns the answer as its result: write nothing else in the same turn, then continue your task based on the answer.

options.description: Proposed choices. Without options: free answer.

multiple.description: With options: the user may choose several (answer: labels separated by commas).

confirm.description: Asks the user for permission before a risky or irreversible action (two buttons) and waits for the decision. The answer is the label of the chosen button; only act after a "yes". The tool BLOCKS until the user answers and returns the answer as its result: write nothing else in the same turn, then continue your task based on the answer.

title.description: What needs to be authorized, phrased as a question.

yes.description: Label of the confirm button (default: Confirm).

no.description: Label of the cancel button (default: Cancel).

form.description: Displays a form when you need several pieces of information at once (rather than several questions) and waits for it to be submitted. The answer is one "Label: value" line per field ("Yes"/"No" for a checkbox, "—" if an optional field is empty). The tool BLOCKS until the user answers and returns the answer as its result: write nothing else in the same turn, then continue your task based on the answer.

updateInstruction: Update applied: the displayed component has changed. Do not write the token.
progressInstruction: The component is already displayed in the chat: do not write this token in your reply. To update it, call the tool again with update = this token and the complete state of the steps.

guide.description: Returns the guide for building AgentUI apps (React + backend shown in the Apps tab): file layout, UI components, CSS variables, backend API, rules. READ IT BEFORE creating or modifying an app.

create.description: Creates (or renames) an app shown in the Apps tab of AgentUI. Then send its files with agentui_app_write. Call agentui_app_guide first if you have not read the guide.

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

name.description: Name displayed in the Apps tab.

icon.description: Icon name from the guide (default: apps).

write.description: Writes files of an app (created or replaced) then builds it. Paths: src/main.tsx (required, default-exports the root React component), other src/** modules, and server/<route>.js for the backend. Returns {ok:true} or {ok:false, errors:[{file,line,message}]}: on errors, fix and write again (the previous working version stays online).

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

read.description: Reads a file of one of your apps.

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

list.description: Lists your apps with their files.

delete_file.description: Deletes a file of one of your apps then rebuilds it.

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

remove.description: Permanently deletes an app with its files and its data. Only on explicit request of the user (ask for confirmation with agentui_confirm first).

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

logs.description: Recent backend logs of an app (console.log output, handler errors, timeouts) — use it to debug server/*.js.

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2-40 characters, starting with a letter (e.g. habit-tracker).

data.description: Reads or writes the data of one of your apps (the same collections and key/value store its backend handlers see through ctx.db / ctx.kv). Use it to push data into an app from outside a user request — typically from a cron job or after fetching something yourself — and to inspect what the app stored. Open iframes refresh automatically. Actions: find (collection, filter?, limit?, sort?, desc?), get (collection, doc_id), insert (collection, doc), update (collection, doc_id, doc = fields to merge), remove (collection, doc_id), kv_get / kv_delete (key), kv_set (key, value).
